title: pm-dispatch: rule A (the first consumer raises the @objectstack/spec floor in the same PR) has no subject since objectui computes its floors from the commit pin at publish — retire dispatch-runbook.md lines 211–213
body:
**Filing gate ①, a defect in the lane's own rule text with a named landing** — the follow-up owed by landed work (#24276), pre-declared on that card by the objectui `domain:ui` seat's note `6248946273` and carried since as the skills seat post's cross-lane memo (「when objectstack-ai/objectui#12958 closes, re-read rule A for retirement or re-scoping」). objectstack-ai/objectui#12958 closed `completed` on 2026-10-19T06:37Z. Filed by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`os-justin`, session `session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85`). ⛔ Not a claim. Filed bare: lane, grade and type are triage's (`cross-repo-coordination.md:37`).

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` lane seat, in one text PR that deletes three lines of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` (governed, Tier S: at-tier contract review, then the seat lands it). Expected reader of the PR: the next dispatching seat, which today is told to put a manifest floor into every first consumer's claim.

**Dedupe:** REST enumeration of this repository, `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=all&since=2026-10-17T00:00:00Z&per_page=100` (8 pages, 778 items, pull requests skipped), title+body matched against `/12958|rule A\b|objectstack-floor|spec floor|下限/i` → 3 hits: #24276 (closed, the parent) and the two seat posts #7623 / #12708 whose ledgers carry the memo. objectstack-ai/objectui, same enumeration (1 page, 100 items) against `/rule A\b|dispatch-runbook|retire.*floor/i` → 0. No open card on point. (The search API is not reachable from this session; the enumeration is the dedupe.)

## What is wrong (objectstack `origin/main` `d20bf9b09`)

`dispatch-runbook.md` lines 211–213, under 〈派发词构造细则〉, verbatim (`grep -n '首个消费者' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` → 1 hit, line 211):

```
- 卡的代码首读 spec 发布 R 首发的键、类型成员或运行时行为,即 R 的首个消费者:
- 同 PR 把消费包 `@objectstack/spec` 下限抬到 R,认领文件面点名 manifest 与 lockfile specifier。
- 「不动 pin」只禁 lockfile 解析版本与 `.objectui-sha`/console pin 的移动,⛔ 永不禁下限。
```

They are rule A of #24276, landed by PR #24315 (`83048c686`) on 2026-10-18 for the objectui#12873 / objectui#12939 incident: a published `@object-ui/app-shell` declared `^18.0.0-next.2` while its code needed a `next.3` export. The rule's premise is that the `@objectstack/spec` floor objectui ships is the range a developer writes into the consuming package's manifest, so the first consumer's PR must raise it.

That premise ended with objectstack-ai/objectui#12958 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13024, `4484a1104`, merged 2026-10-19T06:37Z), which executes the maintainer's ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955 (objectui consumes `@objectstack/*` by commit, `.objectstack-sha`). On objectui `origin/main`:

- `package.json` → `"changeset:publish": "node scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs && node scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs && node scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs && changeset publish"`.
- `scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs` header: 「THE FLOOR is the earliest `@objectstack/spec` version npm carries whose objectstack release tag `@objectstack/spec@<version>` contains the pin (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`)」 and 「THE RANGES, in every dependency field of every published manifest: one below the floor becomes `^<floor>` … One at or above the floor stays as written … The writes are the runner's; the tagged commit keeps `main`'s ranges.」
- `scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs` lines 13–14: 「Since objectui#12958 the floors it judges at publish (and nightly) are computed from `.objectstack-sha` by `scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs`, which runs first.」

What each line now does:

1. Line 212 — a floor raised by hand in the first consumer's PR is recomputed from the pin at publish regardless; the claim's file-surface instruction (manifest + lockfile specifier) is idle work for the developer and names an expected file the seat's review then looks for in vain.
2. Line 213 — the clause existed so that a 「不动 pin」 brief could not block the floor. In the pin era the move a first consumer needs is the `.objectstack-sha` bump, which *is* the pin, and that bump is rule B's bump card read from the hold index (`triage-duties.md:30–31`). A brief that says 「不动 pin」 is now the correct instruction (the PR waits on the bump card via `Restart-when:`), so the clause protects nothing; its `.objectui-sha`/console-pin vocabulary is objectui-era wording.
3. Line 211 is the header sentence of the two.

No remaining subject anywhere the lane dispatches:

- objectstack itself depends on `@objectstack/spec` only through `workspace:` ranges (`git grep -nE '"@objectstack/spec": *"[^w]' origin/main -- '**/package.json'` → 1 hit, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/package.json`, a scaffold template, not a consumer).
- hotcrm pins exact published versions (`lanes/hotcrm.md:43` 「依赖是已发布的 `@objectstack/*` 包,逐包定版号,非 git pin」) — a bump, never a range floor.
- cloud consumes by `.objectstack-sha` bump cards (`triage-duties.md:28`).

Cost today: every claim the seat writes for a card whose code first reads a new spec key is told to name a manifest and a lockfile specifier that the consumer's publish step overwrites; the developer either does the idle edit or deviates from the dispatch order, and the review has one expected-file line that cannot be verified against anything real.

## Premises, each with its re-check (run before dispatch; any failure ⇒ report a fork, do not implement)

1. objectui `origin/main` computes floors at publish: `git -C /home/user/objectui fetch origin main && git -C /home/user/objectui show origin/main:package.json | grep changeset:publish` → the line starts with `node scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs &&`.
2. objectstack-ai/objectui#12958 is closed by a merged PR: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/pulls/13024` → `merged: true`, `merge_commit_sha` starting `4484a1104`.
3. The three lines are at 211–213 on `origin/main` and nowhere else in the tree: `grep -rnE '永不禁下限|首个消费者|下限抬到' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git .` → 3 hits, all `dispatch-runbook.md:211–213`.
4. Rule B is untouched by this card: `grep -n 'hold 索引' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` → lines 30–31.

## What to change

- One PR, one file: delete lines 211–213 of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`. −3 lines, nothing added, 241 → 238 against the file's ceiling of 241; the 120-byte line cap is not engaged.
- The CEILINGS row for the file (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, 241) stays as it is by default — the ratchet's own header calls the headroom 「the budget for ordinary rule edits between compressions」 and the file has had none. Lowering it to 238 is legitimate if the dispatching seat prefers; then the PR is two files and the ratchet's self-test runs.
- Rule B (`triage-duties.md:30–31`) and the hold-index wording stay as they are.
- Re-scoping was weighed and is not taken: re-scoping A to 「consumers that declare semver ranges by hand」 leaves a rule with no subject (the three readings above); restating it for the pin era (「a first consumer of an unpinned commit waits on the bump card via `Restart-when:`」) would duplicate rule B and what objectui CI already does, since a build against a pin that lacks the key fails before any publish.

## Why this is not a decision card

`SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉 lists 说明书脱节 and 纯文档措辞更正 (no contract declaration changed) among the classes that never escalate, and `triage-duties.md:40` keeps 说明书脱节 out of the decision box when a ruling source exists. The ruling source is the maintainer's letter B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955 (ruling record objectui comment `6248859734`), executed by objectstack-ai/objectui#12958. Rule A was maintainer-directed on 2026-10-18 (「立卡吧,A 和 B 都要」, #24276) before that ruling's execution had landed; the lane's memo pre-declared this re-read. This card and the Tier S review are the maintainer's veto window, not a permission gate.
